caption: The drawing features a single pitcher-shaped object centered on a plain, light beige background. The body of the pitcher is predominantly blue, with a brown base and handle. The blue area has a transparent quality in the upper part, revealing a light tan color underneath. On the left side of the pitcher, there is a stylized bird colored in shades of tan, yellow, and gold, depicted with its wings open as if in flight. The bird is surrounded by three small, multicolored flowers with pink petals and green leaves, each placed separately on the blue surface. The handle and decorative elements on the left and center of the pitcher are shaped like brown, textured leaves or feathers, giving it an ornate appearance. The lines and colors are softly blended, creating a smooth and harmonious composition.
title: Majolica Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
